title: Order Granting in Part Motion to Amend Scheduling Order, Notice of Technical Conference, Notice of Public Witness Hearing, and Notice of Hearing (Docket No. 23-057-16)
text:
- BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF UTAH - 

Joint Application of Questar Gas Company 
dba Dominion Energy Utah and Enbridge 
Quail Holdings, LLC for Approval of the 
Proposed Sale of Fall West Holdco, LLC 
to Enbridge Quail Holdings, LLC 

DOCKET NO. 23-057-16 

ORDER GRANTING IN PART MOTION TO 
AMEND SCHEDULING ORDER, NOTICE OF 
TECHNICAL CONFERENCE, NOTICE OF 
PUBLIC WITNESS HEARING, AND NOTICE 
OF HEARING 

ISSUED: February 29, 2024 

On November 7, 2023, the Public Service Commission (PSC) issued a 
Scheduling Order, Notice of Technical Conference, Notice of Public Witness Hearing, 
and Notice of Hearing in this docket (the “Scheduling Order”). The Scheduling Order 
set certain dates that included, as relevant here, the deadlines for filing rebuttal and 
surrebuttal testimony, and the dates for the public witness and evidentiary hearings. 

On February 27, 2024, Dominion Energy Utah (DEU) filed a Motion to amend the 
Scheduling Order (“Motion”). The Motion represents that the parties in this docket – 
DEU, Enbridge Quail Holdings, LLC, the Division of Public Utilities, the Office of 
Consumer Services, the Utah Association of Energy Users, and the Idaho Public 
Utilities Commission (“Parties”) – “have engaged in settlement discussions and believe 
they are likely to reach a settlement in this” docket. The Motion requests the PSC “to 
amend the Scheduling Order such that the March 4th [rebuttal testimony filing 
deadline] would be vacated, and rebuttal testimony would be due on March 29, 2024. 
All other dates, deadlines, and provisions of the Scheduling Order would remain the 
same.” The Motion further represents that DEU has “discussed this Motion with all of 
DOCKET NO. 23-057-16 

- 2 - 

the Parties and … is authorized to represent that all Parties support this Motion.” The 
Motion does not address the Scheduling Order’s surrebuttal deadline of March 29, 
2024. 

Good cause appearing, and based on DEU’s representations that the Parties 
support the Motion, the Motion is granted in part as follows: 
1. The current deadline of March 4, 2024, for filing rebuttal testimony is vacated; 
2. The new deadline for filing rebuttal testimony is March 29, 2024; 
3. The new deadline for filing surrebuttal testimony is April 8, 2024; 
4. All other dates, times, and locations in the Scheduling Order (i.e., the 
evidentiary hearing and public witness hearing) remain unchanged. 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC WITNESS HEARING 

The PSC will conduct a Public Witness Hearing in this docket on Thursday, April 
11, 2024, beginning at 5:00 p.m., Fourth Floor Hearing Room 403, Heber M. Wells 
Building, 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah. The Public Witness Hearing will 
continue until all present individuals have had a reasonable opportunity to address 
the PSC. Individuals planning to address the PSC must be present by 5:30 p.m. 

The PSC may limit remarks that are unduly repetitious at the Public Witness 
Hearing. The PSC desires to provide an opportunity for all individuals who desire to 
speak to do so. As such, the PSC may limit the length of individuals’ remarks. Any 
individual wishing to present a statement of position to the PSC that is unable to do so 
during the Public Witness Hearing may file a written statement of position with the 
DOCKET NO. 23-057-16 

- 3 - 

PSC at its office, Fourth Floor, Heber M. Wells Building, 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake 
City, Utah 84111 in person, by mail, by email to psc@utah.gov, or by facsimile to 801-
530-6796. Please indicate that the statement pertains to Docket No. 23-057-16. 

Individuals wishing to participate in the Public Witness Hearing by telephone 
should contact the PSC two days in advance by calling (801) 530-6716 or (toll-free) 1-
866-PSC-UTAH (1-866-772-8824) to receive a bridge number and participant 
passcode. Participants attending by telephone should then call the bridge number five 
minutes before the Public Witness Hearing, entering the passcode followed by the # 
sign to ensure participation. 

Individuals needing accommodations during the Public Witness Hearing should 
notify the PSC at 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, (801) 530-6716, at 
least three working days prior to the Public Witness Hearing. 

NOTICE OF HEARING 

An evidentiary hearing in this docket will be conducted on Thursday, April 11, 
2024, beginning at 9:00 a.m., Fourth Floor Hearing Room 403, Heber M. Wells Building, 
160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah. All parties must have their witnesses in 
attendance and prepared to testify. Parties should also reserve Friday, April 12, 2024, 
in the event the hearing lasts more than one day. Any person desiring to attend this 
event must show government-issued photo identification to be admitted past the 
building security station.

the PSC two days in advance by calling (801) 530-6716 or (toll-free) 1-866-PSC-

Participants attending by telephone should then call the bridge number five minutes

Individuals needing accommodations during the hearing should notify the PSC 
at 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, (801) 530-6716, at least three 
working days prior to the hearing.
